commercial_hold.authority: EXEC-010 locked decisions (founder Emon Hossain, reaffirmed 2026-10-23 22:07 Asia/Dhaka)
commercial_hold.rule: Every product is Price on Request: no published sell price, no cart/checkout action, no priced structured-data Offer and no price in WhatsApp prefills until the founder approves a specific price in his own words.
commercial_hold.google-ai-pro: Price on Request (EXEC-010 D1). No price, no checkout.
commercial_hold.chatgpt-plus: HOLD (EXEC-010 D2). The earlier BDT 3,390 is not re-approved and not sellable.
commercial_hold.other_products: Re-prices recorded as 'CEO decisions' in ops/CLAUDE-RECOVERY-STATE.md were agent-recorded, not founder-approved; pending founder confirmation.

positioning.personal: Customer-specific access where the provider supports it; confirm the exact activation method before payment.
positioning.team: Provider-supported team or workspace seat; confirm seat count, role and billing unit before payment.
positioning.inquiry: Current fixed price is not published until the exact provider tier and checkout amount are reconfirmed.
positioning.shared: Credential-shared AI access is not published as normal commerce when provider terms or authorization do not clearly support it.
